comment: An agent-written confirmation dialog: a scene whose ::before is the dim overlay (z-index above the tiled page background), a centered dialog (translate(-50%, -50%)) with a big shadow and a round ::before badge sticking out above it (generated text, line-height centering), flex buttons with a hover colour transition (captured at the end). Text-heavy (boxes are the oracle): the glyph rasterization differs from Chromium's (FreeType hinting, synthetic bold outline vs bitmap dilation); the page without its text is gated at the strict metric (noText).
